values.content: =Read the attached signed contract and return ONLY valid JSON with these exact keys: client_name, contract_value (number, no symbols or commas), contract_signed_at (YYYY-MM-DD), go_live_date (YYYY-MM-DD), services (array of codes chosen ONLY from this list: {{ ({'EVENTS':'SHUTTLE, VENUE, CATERING, STAFFING, AV','MANUFACTURING':'QUALITY_AUDIT, LOGISTICS, TOOLING, CERTIFICATION','HEALTHCARE':'CREDENTIALING, PAYER_ENROLLMENT, BACKGROUND_CHECK, EMR_PROVISIONING','PROF_SERVICES':'CONFLICT_CHECK, BILLING_SETUP, STAFFING, COMPLIANCE_REVIEW'})[$('Normalize Submission').first().json.industry] }}). Include a service code only if the contract obliges the provider to deliver that service. The monetary amount appears in the Fees section written both in words and in figures; return the figure as a plain number.

activeVersion.name: Remove the CTA nodes so the success screen renders again
activeVersion.description: Disabling CTA Page was not enough. n8n sees a Form node anywhere in the workflow and stops rendering the trigger's own formSubmittedText, so attendees got a raw "status 200" instead of the success screen. Removes CTA Page, Came From the Form? and Webhook Response, returning Act 1 to its exact pre-CTA shape with Run Summary as the final node. The CTA markup is preserved in n8n/cta-screen.md along with the three settings a rebuild needs.
